brief:
The European Parliament granted the Sakharov Prize for Freedom of Thought to the International Criminal Court and its officials on October 22, 2026, Human Rights Watch reported. The award recognizes the court's work in pursuing accountability for serious crimes.

The Sakharov Prize, established in 1988, honors individuals and organizations defending human rights and fundamental freedoms. The ICC received the award amid ongoing international conflicts and calls for accountability for mass atrocities.
dek: The European Parliament on October 22, 2026, awarded the Sakharov Prize for Freedom of Thought to the International Criminal Court (ICC) and its officials.
title: European Parliament awards Sakharov Prize to ICC
